label: Finding-45
title: offline-allies: Australia is not-shown, not contradicted, and the EU part largely holds
description: ACSC's page lists other actions and no offline advice, but its body text is stale (pre-patch) and absence on one page is not a contradiction. For 'the EU', CERT-EU advises isolating internet-facing applications from public networks, CERT-FR recommends isolating affected equipment, ACN advises taking sites offline, and CERT.LV says systems that cannot be updated must have internet access restricted. Only NCSC-NL, ENISA's CNW page and JPCERT give no such advice.
